_description: Per-morale-tier bandit-spawn density. Bandits spawn when morale ≤ -2 (Turbulent or worse). Numerator/denominator give 'one bandit per N families' density; bandit_count = floor(total_families / family_denominator). NPC challenger emergence chance is cumulative monthly per tier.

Rebellious.comment: one bandit per family per L557

Defiant.comment: one bandit per two families per L568

Turbulent.comment: one bandit per five families per L576
